title: Properties of giant molecular clouds in the strongly barred galaxy NGC 1300
question: Do GMC properties (radius, velocity dispersion, mass, virial parameter) differ between bar, arm and bar-end regions of the strongly barred galaxy NGC 1300, where star formation efficiency differs?

what.value: M51 spiral-arm GMC catalog used as comparison sample

evidence.quote: we compare the properties of GMCs in spiral arms of proto-type spiral galaxy of M51 by (cite: Colombo:2014ei)

what.value: Systemic velocity 1511 km/s with Virgo/Great Attractor/Shapley corrections, used for the 20.7 Mpc distance

evidence.quote: with those from Nobeyama 45-m single-dish telescope by (cite: Maeda:2018bg)

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image the 12CO(1-0) two-field mosaic
recipe.method: Observatory calibration script in CASA 5.1.1; concat of the two pointings; tclean multiscale CLEAN mosaic in CASA 5.4.0; primary-beam correction
key_parameters: multiscale scales 1, 2, 5 x synthesized beam; Briggs robust = 0.5

recipe.method: 3-D clump finding with CPROPS: islands above threshold, watershed decomposition into clouds
key_parameters: SIGDISCONT = 0.0 (each local maximum is an independent cloud)
NONUNIFORM flag used for spatially varying rms noise
Islands allowed with pixels above 4 sigma in only one channel

recipe.goal: Measure and derive GMC physical properties
recipe.method: CPROPS moment measurements extrapolated to zero sensitivity and deconvolved; L_CO from F_CO and distance; M_mol = alpha_CO L_CO; virial mass, surface density, virial parameter and scaling coefficient from R and sigma_v
assumptions: alpha_CO = 4.4 Msun (K km/s pc^2)^-1, including a factor 1.36 for helium
Spherical cloud with rho proportional to r^-n, n = 1; magnetic fields and external pressure negligible

recipe.method: Mass-completeness limit from minimum detectable GMC; resolved sample requires Mmol >= 5e5 Msun and R > 15 pc, mass-complete sample Mmol > 2e5 Msun

recipe.goal: Test environmental variation of GMC properties
recipe.method: Two-sided two-sample K-S test between Bar, Arm and Bar-end; p-value and uncertainty from 100 resampled realizations (median and MAD)
key_parameters: Significant if p < 0.01, marginal for 0.01 to 0.05
T_peak uncertainty taken as the cube rms, 0.36 K

recipe.method: Spearman rank correlation and ordinary least-squares fits for size-velocity dispersion, virial-luminous mass, size-mass and sigma_v^2/R versus Sigma_mol for resolved GMCs
Truncated power-law cumulative mass function (Williams and McKee 1997) fitted to GMCs above 5e5 Msun; errors from 100 resampled realizations
key_parameters: 100 resampling realizations; median and MAD adopted as best fit and interval

recipe.goal: Assess systematics: CPROPS bias and missing flux
recipe.method: CASA simobserve of mock 3-D Gaussian GMCs followed by tclean and CPROPS; flux-recovery test with Gaussian sources and comparison with Nobeyama 45-m spectra
key_parameters: log Mmol 5.3-6.8, log R 1.5-2.2, log sigma_v 0.3-1.1; axis ratio 1.0; 12 repeats; S/N 4-10 extracted

evidence.quote: The resultant rms noise is 0.51 $\rm mJy~beam^{-1}$, corresponding to 0.36 K.
The final data cube has an angular resolution of $0.44^{\prime\prime} \times 0.30^{\prime\prime}$.
CPROPS identified 233 GMCs in the data cube.
The mass completeness limit is estimated to be $2.0 \times 10^5 ~M_\odot$

evidence.loc: 5.1 Variation of GMC physical properties with environment

evidence.quote: $M_{\rm vir} \propto M_{\rm mol}^{0.70 \pm 0.35}$ in the whole region

evidence.quote: We find that the average recovery fraction is 54 % with typical uncertainty of 5 %

answer_key.quantity: Overestimate of sigma_v by CPROPS for narrow lines

evidence.quote: CPROPS overestimates $\sigma_v$ by a factor of $\sim 1.5$ regardless of S/N
